snippet.title: MOP'N SPARK Alpha Trailer
snippet.description:
『MOP'N SPARK』は、掃除人と電気工事士、異色の２人が協力して挑む2Dパズルプラットフォーマです。

"MOP'N SPARK" is a 2D puzzle platformer where a street cleaner and an electrician—an unlikely duo—team up to tackle challenging stages.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3491720/MOPN_SPARK/
